basic_info.description: Rare and exquisite opportunity for the right buyer or family of buyers.  Back-to-back (2) homes on 1 lot with a shared backyard could potentially be parceled and split.  Plans and Application ALREADY SUBMITTED for Variance.  44 Cortland has new exterior siding and new entry stairs.  Each home is almost equal in size but unique in character.  44 Cortland Avenue is a 1914-built charmer with 3 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, and additional basement/garage space.  43 Santa Marina is a 1992-built tri-level building with 2 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, a loft with views of the Financial District.  Designed with iconic curved walls and expansive windows, this home is a tribute to the previous owner and visionary architect who created it.  Experience the perfect blend of modern design and timeless elegance in this one-of-a-kind residence.  Situated near and across shops, amenities of Bernal Heights, 44 Cortland/43 Santa Marina both sit only a 20-minute walk away from the peak of Bernal Heights Park.  Under $700/sq ft.
